documents.text: Monkey Grip (film) Monkey Grip is a 1982 Australian drama film directed by Ken Cameron. It is based on the novel, also titled "Monkey Grip", by Helen Garner. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section the 1982 Cannes Film Festival. The film was produced by Patricia Lovell and stars Noni Hazelhurst and Colin Friels. Ken Cameron tried to get up a film version of Helen Garner's novel in early 1979 but could not raise the budget of $553,000.
